test_ProcessGroupStatsMonitor: test the ProcessGroupStatsMonitor class to verify it spawns a subprocess and terminates it on cancel
test_read_pgrp_stats: test the _read_pgrp_stats function to verify it aggregates CPU, memory, and disk I/O for the current process group
test_collect_pgrp_stats: test the _collect_pgrp_stats function to verify it returns a complete snapshot with CPU percent and network deltas
test_parse_proc_stat: test the _parse_proc_stat function to verify it correctly parses /proc/[pid]/stat content including comm fields with spaces and parens
test_parse_smaps_rollup: test the _parse_smaps_rollup function to verify it extracts PSS and private memory values from /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup
